name: jidian

scripts.start: npm run build && NODE_ENV=production tsx server/index.ts
scripts.desktop:dev: concurrently -k -n vite,electron -c blue,green "vite" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env NODE_ENV=development APP_RUNTIME=desktop electron ."
scripts.desktop:build: npm run build && npm run build:server && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.js --mac zip dmg --arm64 && node electron/restore-native-deps.js
scripts.desktop:build:dir: npm run build && npm run build:server && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.js --dir --arm64 && node electron/restore-native-deps.js
scripts.desktop:build:universal: npm run build && npm run build:server && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.js --mac zip dmg --universal && node electron/restore-native-deps.js

description: 基点是一个本地运行的基金与股票投资记录工具，支持历史价格同步、交易管理与持仓分析。
